steps.content: [UGC Equity Regulations, 2026] The University Grants Commission (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026, commonly referred to as the UGC Equity Regulations, 2026 or the Anti-Discrimination Rules, 2026, are regulations notified by the University Grants Commission (UGC) in India aimed at addressing discrimination within higher education institutions (HEIs). The regulations seek to replace the existing 2012 regulations with more stringent measures to ensure inclusion for students from marginalized backgrounds, particularly the Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Other Backward Classes (OBC). The bill saw protests against the Bharatiya Janta Party (BJP) across the country. On January 29, 2026, the Supreme Court of India stayed the University Grants Commission (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026. These regulations, also known as the Anti-Discrimination Rules, aimed to address discrimination in higher education institutions and were intended to replace the existing 2012 regulations. The stay was issued amidst protests against the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) regarding these regulations. 

FINAL: The Supreme Court of India stayed the UGC Equity Regulations, 2026.

final_answer: The Supreme Court of India stayed the UGC Equity Regulations, 2026.
